title: Shared-Structure Drying Chamber Multiplier, Water Damage Mitigation
content:
Water Damage Mitigation rate note. Water that stood in a shared building spreads into the neighbouring structure and widens the drying chamber: a structure multiplier of 1.15 applies to the drying estimate on a condo unit or multifamily unit whose opened date is one or more days after its loss date, 1.1 on a commercial property whose opened date is one or more days after its loss date, and in any other case no structure multiplier applies.

The property type, loss date and opened date are those on the job record; days are calendar days.

## Combinations
| Property type | Opened on the loss date | Opened one or more days after |
|---|---|---|
| condo unit | none | 1.15 |
| multifamily unit | none | 1.15 |
| commercial | none | 1.1 |
| single-family home or any other type | none | none |

## Illustration (hypothetical)
A drying estimate of $2000.00 on a multifamily unit opened two days after the loss becomes $2300.00 under the multiplier of 1.15.
